questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: When using he, she, or it, we add -s to the verb. So "she plays" is correct.

questions.question: What do we add to the verb when the subject is "he"?
questions.explanation: We add -s to the verb when the subject is he, she, or it. Example: He runs fast.

questions.question: Which is correct: "I like" or "I likes"?
questions.explanation: With "I", we dont add -s. So "I like" is correct.

questions.question: Vel rett: "The dog ___ fast."
questions.explanation: "The dog" is the same as "it", so we add -s: "The dog runs fast."

questions.question: What happens to the verb "go" with "he"?
questions.explanation: When a verb ends in -o, we add -es. So "go" becomes "goes" with he, she, it.
